observations: Photo 0 shows a large rectangular solar panel with many small cells; there is a glare/bright reflection across the glass.
Photo 1 shows the back/underside of the same panel: a plain white/metal back sheet with mounting frame and two cable ends/ports visible near the bottom area.
Photo 2 shows the back/underside again from a slightly different angle; cable ends are visible.
Photo 3 shows the back/underside again; no clear brand/model label is readable on the panel or frame in these images.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: No battery is shown in the provided photos; only a solar panel is visible.
No battery condition/history is shown; no repair indicators or serial/inspection records are visible.

risks.risk: The item shown may be only a solar panel, while the seller claims about a battery (mismatch).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the exact battery being sold (front label/brand, terminals, and a close-up of the rating plate/serial).
risks.if_unproven: Price as solar panel only (battery not included / battery performance not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Solar panel wattage (e.g., 100W/150W/200W/others) is not readable, which strongly affects price.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the panel’s label/rating plate showing Wp (watts), Voc, Isc, and brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest plausible category for used panels in the market (worst-case wattage).

risks.risk: Panel condition (cracks, delamination, water ingress) cannot be confirmed due to glare and lack of close-ups.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the frame corners and the cell grid (no glare), plus a photo of the back for any burn marks/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition (no performance guarantee).

risks.risk: Electrical performance is unknown (no test results like open-circuit voltage under sun or IV curve).
risks.proof: Ask for a working test: measured Voc and Isc (or a simple multimeter reading) under sunlight, or a video showing the readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not performance-tested (assume reduced output).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the solar panel rating label showing brand, model, and wattage (Wp).
Confirm whether a battery is included; if yes, send battery photos (label/rating plate + terminals + serial).
Provide a simple performance test (Voc and Isc) or a short video of the measurements in daylight.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a solar panel, but the seller’s claims are about a battery (not shown). Also, the panel’s wattage/label is not readable, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the key identifying specs.
